payload.reason: The evidence indicates that additional fine-tuning on CLIP was not included in the experiments because it performed worse than using extracted features for classification, likely due to the small size of the labeled dataset.

claims.text: Additional fine-tuning on CLIP was not included because it performed worse than using extracted features for classification with SVM.
The poor performance of fine-tuning CLIP is attributed to the relatively smaller sized labeled dataset, which was insufficient for effective fine-tuning.
